summary: Connect devices through a WireGuard-based private network with centrally managed access policies. Use the hosted service or deploy the management server yourself.
overview: NetBird handles peer connectivity and gives you policies for deciding which devices can reach which resources. Identity-provider integration connects access to user accounts, while the management layer coordinates the private network. In a homelab, this can provide a way to reach services across locations without making each individual application directly accessible from the public internet.
